summary: Contact Edit feature end-to-end tested across Lead, Customer, WA Contact (wa_contacts), and Inbox Conversation. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases passed (CRUD, duplicate 409, invalid phone 400, RBAC 403 for site user). Frontend: verified data-testids and dialog flows for superadmin on all four surfaces; UI edit of lead name persisted via API verification; WA contact edit submitted & persisted.
critical_code_review_comments: wa_contacts._parse_csv has a brittle header-detection heuristic: when the input is a single free-text line like 'Namakontak 0812xxxxxxxx' and the token contains any PHONE_COLS substring ('wa', 'tel', 'hp', 'number', 'kontak' overlap, etc.), the whole single row is misread as a header with pi=0 and the import silently returns 0 rows. Confirmed by test — the string 'TEST_WaCt_... 0856xxxxxxxx' fails to import because 'wa' is detected in the pseudo-header. Consider only entering the header branch when the input has >1 row (i.e. a real tabular shape) or when the detected phone column actually resolves to a phone-token in rows[1:]. Low-priority bug but silently breaks imports via text paste that happen to contain phone-column keywords in names.
frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL points to https://dadada-dev.preview.emergentagent.com — all tests used it. OK.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of covered flows (admin lead/customer/wa/inbox edit buttons + dialogs + persisted edits)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: imports 1-2 wa_contacts (Budi/KontakA/KontakB) via POST /api/wa/contacts/import and deletes them in fixture teardown. Creates+deletes a test lead and customer. Simulates one WA inbound to create a conversation for inbox-edit tests (conversation is not deleted; name/phone restored to original). The UI run temporarily renamed one real lead to 'UI_LeadRenamed' then deleted the lead it created (no mutation of pre-existing demo data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_contact_edit.py exercises PUT /api/leads/{id}, PUT /api/customers/{id}, PUT /api/wa/contacts/{cid}, PUT /api/inbox/{conv_id}/contact and the matching 403/400/409 edge cases. UI data-testids under constants/testIds/contactEdit.js all render for leads:update holder (superadmin) and persist edits via API. If re-running, note that creating wa_contacts via text import requires the name token to NOT contain any PHONE_COLS keywords (wa, tel, hp, kontak, number, mobile, phone) — otherwise _parse_csv treats the single line as a header. See critical_code_review_comments.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works as intended end-to-end.
